description_en: Queries the address where you can download the log data of a specific domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnDomainLogs查询域名的离线日志下载地址
name: DescribeCdnDomainLogs

parameters.help_en: The domain name. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **300**. Maximum value: **1000**. Valid values: **1** to **1000**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page **1**
parameters.help_zh: 取得第几页，取值范围：大于**1**的任意整数
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取日志起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取日志结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

> 结束时间需晚于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
